items.stem: Which PSTN connectivity option lets an operator manage carrier service directly in the Teams admin center without an SBC?

options.rationale: Correct: Operator Connect lets a participating carrier provide PSTN through the Teams admin center without customer-managed SBCs.
Direct Routing requires a customer- or partner-managed Session Border Controller.
Skype for Business on-premises is not a Teams PSTN option.
A fax gateway does not provide PSTN calling for users.

items.stem: What must you assign to an auto attendant or call queue so it can receive external calls?

options.text: A resource account with a license and phone number
options.rationale: Correct: auto attendants and call queues need a resource account with the appropriate license and phone number.
A user mailbox does not back a voice application.
A shared channel is a collaboration feature, not a voice endpoint.
A meeting policy governs meetings, not call routing.
